source_snapshot.procedure: GET `/redfish/v1` and confirm there is no duplicate data.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; uses curl -k and jq, which weakens endpoint identity and may silently collapse duplicate JSON keys.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE/LOW; requires TLS validation, raw HTTP/body capture, duplicate-aware parsing and service-root schema/link validation.

old_problem: Ordinary jq output cannot prove raw JSON had no repeated object keys, and 'duplicate data' did not distinguish repeated keys, normalized duplicate resource URIs or legitimate repeated values. Required ServiceRoot links and possible HTTP-header coverage were unspecified.
disposition_reason: Redfish standardizes `/redfish/v1` as the service root and provides versioned ServiceRoot schemas. ED-03/15/20 allow the supported profile's required/optional links and semantic URI exceptions as project configuration. Raw-body preservation plus duplicate-key-aware parsing resolves the no-duplicate requirement without relying on a lossy pretty-printer.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2240, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2241 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00023-V001 / 3db8a34f6d5a8c7c was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Verify the exact BMC, firmware, Redfish version/profile and trusted certificate before authentication; credentials never appear in URLs or logs.
GET exactly `/redfish/v1` once and preserve redacted status/headers plus original response-body bytes and hash before parsing.
Validate success status, content type, JSON syntax and raw repeated object keys with a decoder that reports duplicates instead of silently retaining first/last value.
Validate required `@odata` metadata and root links against the signed ServiceRoot profile; preserve permitted OEM/optional fields.
Apply a documented normalization rule to detect duplicate resource URIs or semantic members while exempting approved aliases; identical values in unrelated fields are not automatically duplicates.
Do not follow cross-host redirects or issue PATCH/POST; stop on TLS/auth/status/body/schema ambiguity without corrective retry.
No Redfish request, authentication, mutation, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Redfish ServiceRoot raw representation and duplicate integrity
test_case.purpose: Verify that the intended BMC returns a valid profile-conformant `/redfish/v1` ServiceRoot with successful raw HTTP evidence and no ambiguous duplicate JSON keys or unapproved duplicate root references.
required_package: BMC/firmware/Redfish version and signed ServiceRoot profile/schema
Required/optional `@odata` metadata and root-link matrix plus OEM exceptions
Duplicate definition for raw keys, normalized URIs and semantic members
Trusted TLS certificate/CA, protected session and response-header redaction policy
test_case.test_command: Use a TLS-validated secret-safe client to GET `/redfish/v1` once, save redacted raw status/headers and exact body bytes/hash, run duplicate-key-aware JSON decoding, validate the signed ServiceRoot metadata/link matrix, and apply the approved normalized-resource duplicate rule without mutation.
test_case.expected_result: The endpoint returns the approved success status/content type and valid ServiceRoot document; no raw object key repeats, all mandatory metadata/links are valid, and no unapproved duplicate normalized resource/semantic member exists.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires raw HTTP/body evidence, duplicate-aware decode and profile/link validation. Pretty-printed jq output alone cannot pass. TLS/auth/non-success, malformed/truncated body, raw duplicate key, missing mandatory member or unapproved duplicate URI/member is FAIL. Missing profile/semantic rule blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Verify endpoint certificate and protect credentials/session headers.
One GET only; no cross-host redirect, write or corrective retry.
Capture raw bytes before any parser and redact only secrets, not structural evidence.
Stop on identity, TLS, auth, status, parse or schema ambiguity.
expected_evidence: TLS certificate identity and redacted raw status/headers
Duplicate-aware parser/version and raw repeated-key report
Decoded required metadata/root links and normalized duplicate-resource report
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On transport, parse or schema failure, close the session and preserve raw evidence; do not weaken TLS or mutate Redfish configuration.
